tags.name: Abbey Well
tags.note: Alternate names include: Friary Well, Lady’s Well, Carmelite Abbey Well

tags.description: A Local Norman landowner Robert Fitzrichard Balrain built an Abbey adjacent to a well on this site around the year 1334 and dedicated it to the Blessed Virgin Mary.
